title: AI/ML Engineer
description: A practical path from Python and math foundations to machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, and deployable AI projects.

tree.name: Programming and Math Foundations
tree.description: Build the Python, statistics, and linear algebra base needed to understand models instead of only calling APIs.

children.name: Python, NumPy, and Pandas
children.description: Use notebooks, arrays, data frames, plotting, and clean code for repeatable experiments.

children.name: Statistics and Linear Algebra
children.description: Learn vectors, matrices, probability, distributions, hypothesis testing, and evaluation metrics.

tree.name: Classical Machine Learning
tree.description: Train, validate, tune, and explain supervised and unsupervised models.

resources.title: Complete Machine Learning in 6 Hours (Krish Naik)

children.name: Regression and Classification
children.description: Build baseline models, choose metrics, prevent leakage, and interpret model behavior.

children.name: Feature Engineering and Evaluation
children.description: Create features, split data correctly, tune hyperparameters, and compare models fairly.

children.name: Practice: Model Error Analysis Lab
children.description: Analyze false positives, leakage, bias, and metric tradeoffs on a real dataset before improving the model.

tree.name: Deep Learning and LLMs
tree.description: Move from neural network basics to transformers, computer vision, NLP, and modern generative AI workflows.

resources.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning & Machine Learning (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: PyTorch Training Loops
children.description: Understand tensors, datasets, autograd, training loops, checkpoints, and GPU usage.

children.name: Transformers and Fine-tuning
children.description: Use pretrained models, tokenizers, datasets, fine-tuning, evaluation, and responsible model sharing.

tree.name: MLOps and Portfolio
tree.description: Package models, serve predictions, track experiments, monitor quality, and build interview-ready projects.

children.name: Model APIs and Deployment
children.description: Serve a model through an API, add validation, containerize it, and document the inference contract.

children.name: ML Interviews and Experiment Reports
children.description: Practice ML system design, model tradeoff explanations, error analysis, and concise experiment reports.

children.name: Project: End-to-end AI App
children.description: Build a dataset-to-deployment project with a README, metrics, limitations, and demo UI.
